objective: Train (evolution strategies) an agent that attends to one violated not-all-equal knot, flips one of its distinctions and chooses the next knot to attend to, with and without memory of earlier steps, at n=100; test on unseen instances at n=100 to 800 (stress 1600) of the training family and of a second, local meeting pattern; compare flips, CPU per flip and total CPU (training charged amortized and not) with CaDiCaL, WalkSAT, probSAT, Novelty+, a greedy-where heuristic and a random-move agent. Stop at the frozen decision rule.
title: Learned where-next agent with memory against plain search and tuned local heuristics on planted not-all-equal knot patterns
